notes.title: Version 1.0.0.4 now Live !!! No More Tower
notes.content:
Version 1.0.0.4 Added some changes
- No more Tower just straight forward beating enemy-chief to win the game
- Ability cost was increased from 50 to 100
- Take out Tower Damage abiltiy replaced by 10% Chance to stun on attack
- Monster respawns every 2 turns

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.3 Bring Gem System Back !!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33113959/b9d7cea6d71037ec19a936dd44d8292f3496951a.jpg[/img]
Version 1.0.0.3 now live with these changes
- Instead of upgrading ability by ability point we decide to bring back Gem System so you have to find gem to upgrade ability of your heroes it will cost 50 gems for each ability. you can collect gem by killing heroes, towers, and monsters

- Summon more now you can summon everyturn so gameplay should be faster

- Add Bot Basic and Unfair level we just add bot level for you if basic level is too easy for you lets try Unfair level should a bit more harder

Thank you guys for playing Dimension Of Gameth
if you have any feedback Pls leave it here or visit our Developer Group
[url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/2103888719648118/] Dimension Of Gameth Developer[/url]

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.2 Live Bot is Available !!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33113959/441597dabbfd29fd896e9b8c7f72db341ab2932a.png[/img]Hello guys, we just updated Version 1.0.0.2 With these changes
- Single Player Mode with bot is available for you to taste some gameplay without to playing online game but these bots is not that smart so we will improve and add more challenges for you to play with next
- Gameplay is changed unit's movement now cost 1 action point and you will have 2 action points everyturn but we add auto-movement and attack for units so they will aim the nearest target 

once this game is stable enough we will start to add more hero to this game

thank you for playing Dimension of Gameth
hope you enjoy

if you have any feedback or report bug you can leave it here or visit our developer group

[url=https://www.facebook.com/groups/2103888719648118/]Dimension Of Gameth Developer[/url]

notes.title: What we are doing now?
notes.content:
Since we got a lot of feedbacks that complain about game is difficult to understand the rules and gameplay so we are trying to adapt some  rules and gameplay to be a bit easier. 

and we try to making tutorial mode in gameplay, single player mode with bot to help you practice a little bit more and we plan to finish it in 3 months. 

Thanks guys to playing this game
